# SignalWire SDK for TypeScript

> Build AI voice agents, control live calls over WebSocket (RELAY), and manage SignalWire resources over REST. The documentation for the installed version ships with the package (`@signalwire/sdk`).

Run `npx sw-tsdocs` for a map of the SDK, `npx sw-tsdocs <topic>` for an area, and `npx sw-tsdocs api <name>` for signatures read from the installed declarations. The links below are relative to this file, in the installed package.

## Build AI agents
